<subject>Group Meeting on May 9th</subject>
<body>
We will be having a group meeting on May 9th at 4 PM. We will be discussing portfolio classification, interest rate adjustments, and team restructuring. Pizza will be provided. I would like to have these meetings on a monthly basis to stay on top of the changing market and to keep everyone updated with changes across Credit Risk. If you cannot make the meeting or have something in particular you would like discussed, or have a preference in pizza, please let me know as soon as possible.

Thanks,
Brandon Baker
Specialist
Credit Risk
Halcyon Mutual Bank
Tel: 0113 246 1847
</body>
